title: Relay GateMetricCatalog v1
description: Canonical schema for the GateMetricCatalog (spec section AA). Conditions in GatePolicy reference metrics by name; this catalog defines them deterministically so two engineers cannot implement diverging aggregations. The compiler validates each metric's `source` SQL FROM/JOIN clause against the active canonical-table registry at publish time. A condition referencing an undefined metric is rejected with RELAY-GATE-031; a metric whose source columns no longer resolve in the active schema is rejected with RELAY-GATE-033; a condition whose source-table completeness falls below the metric's `sampling_eligibility` threshold is rejected at evaluation time with RELAY-GATE-038.

schema_version.description: Literal schema version pin (spec AA line 5301).

unit.description: Result unit; ratio[0..1] indicates a fractional value bounded by 0 and 1 inclusive.

source.description: SQL FROM/JOIN clause (or the sentinel 'see aggregation block below' for metrics whose source is a CTE chain inside `aggregation`).

filter.description: SQL WHERE-clause body or the literal 'TRUE'.

aggregation.description: Aggregation expression or CTE chain that produces the metric value.

missing_data.description: Behavior when the source population is empty or below threshold.

sampling_eligibility.description: Threshold on source-table completeness below which the metric is rejected at evaluation time with RELAY-GATE-038.

notes.description: Optional human-readable rationale or design note.

lookup.description: Lookup rule for the baseline (SQL or natural-language directive).
